issues.description: [bug-hunt] Imperial users see their weight in kg across the plan builders and plan overview - unit_preference is ignored. WHERE: src/pages/onboarding/custom/CustomDietBuilder.tsx ~line 264 (weightLabel = fmtKg(v), rendered as '{weightLabel} kg' chip at ~1241) and src/pages/onboarding/custom/PlanReadyOverview.tsx ~362-383 (Goal card: fmtKg(current)/fmtKg(goal) with hardcoded 'Current kg'/'Goal kg' labels) + ~340 ('Weekly pace ... kg/week'). EXPECTED: onboarding Body Stats offers 'lbs / in' (unit_preference='imperial', Screen3_BodyStats/Screen2_BodyGoal both convert input via KG_TO_LB), so a user who picked lbs and typed 165 lbs should keep seeing lbs downstream, like Screen3's delta display and LogWeight already do. ACTUAL: the very next screens (diet builder weight chip, plan-ready Goal Progress card, Weekly pace) render raw kg - the 165 lbs user sees '74.8 kg', which reads like a wrong number. fmtKg is NOT unit-aware despite the comment in CustomDietBuilder claiming it is; data.unit_preference is available in both components' props and simply unused. REPRO: onboarding -> Body Stats -> pick 'lbs / in' -> weight 165 lbs, goal 143 lbs -> continue to the diet builder (weight chip '74.8 kg') and to the plan overview (Goal card '74.8 / 64.9' labeled kg). FIX SHAPE: branch on data.unit_preference==='imperial' to convert with KG_TO_LB and label lbs (same pattern as Screen3_BodyStats weightDelta display).

issues.description: [bug-hunt] Per-meal 'Suggest' swiper ignores the user's saved meal preferences (food dislikes, cuisine, spice, cook time) AND misses the prefetched deck, causing a cold ~14s 'Cooking up ideas...' wait. WHERE: src/pages/onboarding/custom/CustomDietBuilder.tsx ~1500-1504 - MealSuggestionSwiper gets context={diet_type, goal, allergies} only, while every other AI path (handleCoachBuildAll ~664, handleCoachBuildMeal ~822, and the mount prefetch ~572 via buildDietPrefetchBodies) spreads loadBuilderDraft()?.mealPrefs into context. mealDeckKey (custom-plan.service.ts ~271) includes cuisine_preferences/cook_time/spice_level/food_dislikes in the cache key. EXPECTED: after the user answers the MealPrefsSheet (every 'build it all' entry opens it and answers persist in the builder draft), tapping 'Suggest' on a meal should (a) respect those answers - e.g. food_dislikes='paneer' must not surface paneer meals - and (b) hit the enriched deck that was just warmed. ACTUAL: the swiper requests the BASELINE key: suggestions disregard dislikes/cuisine/spice (backend never receives them), and since the mount prefetch warmed the ENRICHED key, the baseline request is a cache miss -> fresh LLM round-trip (~14s) despite QA i-20260612-0b73's instant-open guarantee. Note suggestMealCached's baseline-fallback (~466) only works the other direction (enriched request served from baseline deck), never baseline-request-from-enriched-deck. REPRO: onboarding diet builder -> 'Coach builds all meals' -> answer prefs incl. a dislike -> after build, tap 'Suggest' on any meal: spinner ~14s and cards can include the disliked food. FIX SHAPE: pass {...context, ...(loadBuilderDraft()?.mealPrefs ?? {})} to the swiper context (mirror handleCoachBuildMeal).
